note: P4319 (Pro 28:9) — who turns his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.

dims.v: willful deafness — refusing to hear God's law
the turning-away of the ear from hearing the law — the willful deafness to God's word that poisons even a man's prayers, refusing God's voice yet expecting God's ear
welded to the divine loathing of his hollow prayer

sur (turn aside) — 'if one TURNS AWAY his ear from hearing the law'; to refuse God's word while seeking his favour is hypocrisy. Emergent: willful deafness to the law as the ruin of prayer (cf 15:8; Ps 66:18; Isa 1:15).
divine loathing — God abhors the prayer of the law-refuser
the abhorrence with which God regards even the prayer of one who turns his ear from the law — the divine loathing of a petition offered by a heart that will not hear him
the willful deafness that provokes it (266739)
welded to the refusal of the law that poisons the prayer

toebah (abomination) — 'even his PRAYER is an abomination'; God loathes the prayers of those who spurn his word. Locus external:god — the divine rejection of worship from a disobedient heart (cf 15:8, 29; 28:9).
